import copy,hashlib,inspect,json,pathlib,re,sys,time
from dataclasses import fields
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'src'))
import contract
original=json.loads((root/'logs/original_inventory.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
replay=json.loads((root/'logs/replay_1791364947856535500.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
protected=['src/contract.py','SHA256SUMS.txt',*[p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in sorted((root/'schemas').glob('*.schema.json'))]]
protected_checks={name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==original['files'][name] for name in protected}
assert all(protected_checks.values())
frame=contract.load_frame(root/'examples/synthetic/frame_000001/metadata.json')
original_meta=copy.deepcopy(frame.metadata); count=0
for iteration in replay['iterations']:
    for event in iteration['frames']:
        stamp=event['replay_time']
        assert set(stamp)=={'ns','clock_domain','origin'}
        assert type(stamp['ns']) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+',stamp['ns'])
        assert stamp['clock_domain']=='pc_unix_utc' and stamp['origin']=='replay_host'
        check=copy.deepcopy(frame); check.metadata['replay_time']=copy.deepcopy(stamp)
        contract.validate_frame(check); count+=1
assert frame.metadata==original_meta and count==100
before={p.relative_to(root/'examples/synthetic').as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (root/'examples/synthetic').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
assert before==replay['hashes_before']==replay['hashes_after']
depth,mask=contract.normalize_depth([[0,-1],[float('nan'),float('inf')]],.001)
assert not depth.any() and not mask.any()
try:
    contract.validate_frame(contract.FramePacket(copy.deepcopy(frame.metadata),depth,mask))
except contract.ContractError as error:
    assert error.code=='NO_VALID_DEPTH'; invalid_frame_code=error.code
else:
    raise AssertionError('validate_frame did not reject all-invalid frame')
clock=time.get_clock_info('time')
record={'protected_distribution_files_unchanged':protected_checks,'initial_distribution_matches':sum(x['match'] for x in original['distribution_checks']),'initial_distribution_mismatches':[x['file'] for x in original['distribution_checks'] if not x['match']],'function_signatures':{name:str(inspect.signature(getattr(contract,name))) for name in ['load_frame','iter_frames','normalize_depth','validate_frame']},'FramePacket_fields':[f.name for f in fields(contract.FramePacket)],'replay_timestamps_checked':count,'replay_clock':{'clock_domain':'pc_unix_utc','source':'time.time_ns() / 재생 PC 시스템 벽시계','epoch':'1970-01-01T00:00:00Z / Unix epoch','origin':'replay_host','implementation':clock.implementation,'monotonic':clock.monotonic,'adjustable':clock.adjustable,'reported_resolution_seconds':clock.resolution},'generated_replay_time_used_in_identity_comparison':False,'original_metadata_untouched':frame.metadata==original_meta,'normalize_all_invalid_returns_zero_false':True,'validate_all_invalid_error':invalid_frame_code,'sample_hashes_current':before,'sample_hashes_match_original':True,'new_code_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['src/replay.py','scripts/record_run.py','tests/test_replay.py','tests/test_preprocessing_boundaries.py']},'scope':'추가 규격 준수 점검; 기존 42개 전체 테스트와 100회 세션 재생을 반복 실행하지 않음'}
path=root/'logs'/f'v1_0_0_compliance_{time.time_ns()}.json'
with path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream: json.dump(record,stream,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)); print('준수 점검 기록:',path)
